svg.title: FCOS3D detailed PKL data, training and testing flow
svg.desc: 30 editable steps with source paths, call sequences, inputs, outputs and configuration values. JSON preparation routes removed. Source checked 08 September 2026.
svg.text: Detailed PKL workflow | Functions, files, inputs and outputs | Camera-only model | Source snapshot: 08 Sep 2026
Read each column top to bottom. D10 feeds T03; T10 supplies the checkpoint to E01. E10 branches from E06.
Solid arrows show stage progression; dashed arrows show optional branches. Numbered cross-references keep the full graph uncluttered.

g.text: CALL: NuScenes-format camera images + versioned raw tables
INPUT: samples/CAM_*/; scene, sample, sample_data, sample_annotation,
MODEL INPUT: use_camera=True; use_lidar=False. Converter metadata may
still reference LiDAR. Source files stay in place.
CALLS: create_nuscenes_infos(); then update_pkl_infos() for each split.
INPUT: NuScenes(version, dataroot), official train/val or mini scene
OUTPUT: scene-token sets filtered by availability. Renamed/custom
scenes need compatible split handling; this route uses official names.
INPUT: samples, camera records, sensor calibration, ego poses,
OUTPUT: legacy records with token, cams, transforms, timestamp and
available ground-truth boxes; mmengine.dump() writes infos + metadata.
Convert each split to the v2 schema
OUTPUT: metainfo + data_list. Converts poses to matrices, normalizes
paths and timestamps, and maps categories to class indices.
INPUT: per-camera sample_data_token, annotation boxes and calibrated
OUTPUT: cam_instances[CAM_*] with bbox, bbox_3d, labels, center_2d,
depth, velocity and attributes when present. Called during v2
Write manifests and resolve image paths
has sample_idx, token, images and transforms.
LOADING: ann_file selects a split; data_root + camera data_prefix
resolve image paths. Evaluator ann_file must match the evaluated split.
Expand a keyframe into camera samples
INPUT: one v2 keyframe; load_type=mv_image_based; images and
OUTPUT: one item per camera; sample_idx = keyframe_index * 6 +
camera_index. Retains token and ego2global; attaches camera-specific
INPUT: camera instances, validity fields, labels and velocity.
OUTPUT: gt_bboxes_3d, gt_labels_3d, 2D boxes, centers_2d, depths and
attributes. Appends velocity; replaces NaN velocity with zero.
Build the dataloader and fetch a batch
INPUT: individual camera records; DefaultSampler(shuffle=True) for
OUTPUT -> T03: image samples for transforms. Configured training
batch_size=2 means two camera images, not two six-camera keyframes.
INPUT: FCOS3D config, work directory, optional --amp / --resume and
OUTPUT: runner with model, dataloaders, optimizer, schedule, evaluator
and hooks. RUNNERS.build(cfg) handles a configured custom runner.
INPUT: pretrained initialization or checkpoint. Resume also restores
CONFIG: ResNet-101 + DCNv2 + FPN + FCOSMono3DHead. Fine-tune launcher
can freeze modules; before_train_epoch() controls timed unfreezing.
INPUT <- D10: image path, cam2img and parsed annotations.
OUTPUT: img, 2D/3D boxes, labels, attr_labels, centers_2d and depths.
Targets supervise training; inference only needs image and metadata.
OUTPUT: packed image + Det3DDataSample. Resize keeps pixels, centers_2d
and cam2img aligned; flip updates the corresponding geometry.
INPUT: batch images; active config uses BGR means
[103.530,116.280,123.675], std=1 and padding to a multiple of 32.
OUTPUT: ResNet-101 backbone features -> FPN: five 256-channel feature
INPUT: FPN feature levels; two stacked head convolutions.
OUTPUT: 10-class scores; regression (2 offsets, 1 depth, 3 size, 1 yaw,
2 velocity); direction, attributes and centerness branches.
CALL: SingleStage3DDetector.loss() -> head loss path -> loss_by_feat()
INPUT: predictions, feature locations and per-image ground truth;
OUTPUT: loss_cls, loss_offset, loss_depth, loss_size, loss_rotsin,
loss_centerness; configured loss_velo, loss_dir and loss_attr.
FILE: MMEngine BaseModel / OptimWrapper; active FCOS3D config
INPUT: aggregate differentiable loss. Backward -> gradient clipping ->
DEFAULT RUN: SGD, lr=0.002, momentum=0.9; max gradient norm=35. LR
warmup=500 iterations, milestones=8/11. Fine-tune config lr=0.001.
CONTROL: default 12 epochs, val_interval=1. Every training iteration
OUTPUT: validation predictions follow the test prediction/evaluation
path. No optimization during validation. Overrides may change this
CALL: CheckpointHook; logger and parameter-scheduler hooks
INPUT: learned model parameters, optimizer / scheduler state and run
OUTPUT -> E01: work_dirs/<run>/*.pth plus training logs. Validation
uses the held-out val split; the default test loader reuses that split.
INPUT <- T10: config path + checkpoint path. Guard checks FCOSMono3D
OUTPUT: cfg.load_from = checkpoint; optional CLI overrides. The
configuration guard runs before cfg-options are merged.
INPUT: checkpoint, test_dataloader, test_evaluator and optional
OUTPUT: evaluation-mode model and sequential test batches. Current
test_dataloader = val_dataloader; this is not a separate third dataset
INPUT: image plus camera calibration and metadata; active test
OUTPUT: normalized / padded image tensor and data samples. Test
pipeline does not load training targets for model inference.
Compute predictions at all feature levels
OUTPUT: FCOSMono3DHead.forward() predictions at five scales.
predict_by_feat() processes the resulting per-level tensors for each
INPUT: locations, offset/depth/size/yaw predictions, camera matrix and
OUTPUT: camera-space boxes. Feature-stage decode occurs in
forward_single(); postprocessing reconstructs 3D centers and resolves
CONFIG: nms_pre=1000; score_thr=0.05; rotated NMS threshold=0.8;
OUTPUT: pred_instances_3d with bboxes_3d, scores_3d, labels_3d and
attributes. Thresholds are the checked-in defaults and can be
Collect results and align with samples
INPUT: per-camera predictions; evaluator reads ann_file[data_list] and
OUTPUT: results organized for formatting. Matching sample indices,
keyframe tokens, calibration and evaluator split are essential.
INPUT: camera boxes, scores, labels, attributes and per-camera / ego
OUTPUT: merged NuScenes results_nusc.json; boxes carry sample token,
translation, size, rotation, velocity, class, score and attribute.
Calculate metrics or keep exported results
EVALUATE: compatible official tokens / ground truth -> mAP, NDS and
translation, scale, orientation, velocity and attribute errors.
EXPORT: format_only=True requires jsonfile_prefix. For custom tokens,
export predictions; official metrics require matching official ground
BRANCH FROM E06: --show or --show-dir, with --task mono_det;
OUTPUT: rendered 3D box overlays. This is optional and independent of
metric computation; visualization does not change trained weights.

svg.text: PKL: metainfo + data_list | Camera: img_path, cam2img, cam2ego | Sample: token, sample_idx, ego2global | Targets: cam_instances
Config values describe the checked-in FCOS3D setup; command-line overrides and fine-tune configs can change them. MMEngine names denote framework calls.
All labels and shapes remain editable vector elements. Paths are relative to the repository. The diagram follows the PKL preparation route.
